VERIFIED (official tanshin): Net sales JPY 842,541M (+6.4%); operating profit JPY 190,558M (+0.2%, op margin 22.6%, down from 24.0% on higher cost ratio/personnel/depreciation); ordinary profit JPY 235,591M (+12.2%, boosted by FX gains); net income JPY 167,302M (+7.0%); EPS JPY 2,640.04; ROE 8.3%; equity ratio 91.5%; operating CF JPY 188,917M; investing CF -JPY 107,511M; CapEx JPY 152,701M; FCF JPY 81,405M (FCF margin 9.7%). SBC ~0%: As a Japanese GAAP filer SMC has negligible stock-based comp — only a small Board Benefit Trust (Directors' stock compensation, 11,200 shares) and modest buybacks (JPY 30,018M treasury share purchases in FY26). sbc_pct_revenue and sbc_pct_fcf effectively 0 — strong positive for R9 (no shareholder dilution from comp; share count actually FELL from 67.4M to 63.9M issued via buyback/cancellation).

ESTIMATED: Price JPY 74,240 and mkt cap JPY 4.69T from aggregators (most recent quote ~Jun 19-20 2026; market closed/stale for Jun 22). USD mkt cap ~USD 29.0B at USD/JPY 161.54. Fwd P/E 25.84 (stockanalysis); 5yr-avg forward P/E ~22.5 is an estimate (10yr mean trailing P/E ~24.5 per Macrotrends/Wisesheets; no clean primary 5yr fwd series obtained) => premium ~+15%. PEG ~3.0 is normalized/estimated: on FY27 net-income guidance growth of only +1.6% PEG would be meaningless (~16x); using a mid-cycle ~8% growth gives ~3. ROIC ~10% est (NOPAT ~JPY 135B over operating invested capital ~JPY 1.27T ex-net-cash). ND/EBITDA ~ -3.0x (net cash; EBITDA ~JPY 230B incl D&A).

DROP CLASSIFICATION = not_depressed: Stock is only ~14.5% off its 52-week high (JPY 86,800) and ~20% off the ATH of JPY 93,220 (Mar 2024), yet UP ~44% over the trailing 12 months. This is not a fear-driven crash nor genuine deterioration — it is a high-quality compounder trading near cycle highs after a strong semiconductor-recovery rerate. The only soft spot is flat operating profit / margin compression (22.6% vs 24.0%); ordinary & net profit still grew, FY27 guidance targets JPY 1T revenue (+18.7%). Valuation is a modest premium, not a depressed entry point.
